messages:
elaine: Quick sync: following last week's OOM postmortem, we need consolidated status updates on the KV-cache residency workstreams. Please keep replies concise here — want a single thread for the Friday follow-up.

sam: Did an extended sampling run on the repro cluster. Top alloc stacks look like: runtime.mallocgc, batcher.append, cache/shard.allocItem. Reproduces under high prefix-miss rates. Plan: enable continuous heap sampling on canary nodes for 6h windows nightly to gather distribution. ETA: implement scheduler today, first run tonight.

munir: Deployed eviction tuning MR to staging: increased soft_limit to 0.72 and added recent-access protection window to reduce churn for hot prefixes. In synthetic replays saw ~15% lower average residency and no latency bump so far. Will add an ops-only route-level eviction override (kill-switch) to revert to prior behavior if miss amplification occurs. ETA for override: Wed AM.

ciaran: Experimented with small-object reclamation and alternative free-list refill thresholds. Reduced average pause time in microbenchmarks but still see intermittent refill spikes when batch flushes cluster. Implemented a leaky-bucket backoff on batch flush to smooth bursts. Added a frag-measurement runbook to measure slab fragmentation and per-class residency. Link: https://docs.internal/frag-measure.

kevin: Kicked off a conservative canary (10% traffic) with the new eviction settings + batcher sampler across 6 nodes. Two nodes stable for 4h; one node hit a memory blip and the canary controller auto-rolled that node. Pulling heap traces and perf maps from the rolled-back host. Keeping canary at 10% pending two 24h stable windows.

perf-bot: Canary snapshot (4h): median latency +0.8ms, p95 +3.4ms, residency -11% on canary nodes, one auto-rollback triggered. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/canary/1729876543.

elaine: Short asks:
- sam: turn the nightly 6h sampler into a scheduled job for 7 nights; surface top-5 alloc sites in the canary dashboard and retain samples for 7 days.
- munir: implement route-level eviction override toggle and annotate any usage in telemetry.
- ciaran: add pause-duration histogram to incident dashboard and tag >5ms events for triage.
- kevin: keep canary at 10%, document rollback signal and artifacts gathered.

sam: Acknowledged. Will PR the sampler pipeline + dashboard widgets and include a README for retrieving continuous heaps. Retention 7 days by default to control storage.

munir: Acknowledged. Will add ops-only toggle and telemetry tag so we can correlate flips to latency. ETA Wed AM.

ciaran: Adding pause histogram and alert: >2 occurrences of >5ms in 1h triggers a paged ticket. Also leaving note: if eviction tuning doesn't resolve fragmentation, next step is slab-size rebalancing.

kevin: Holding canary at 10%. If we observe a second rollback, will scale to 0% and run deeper tracing across the affected hosts. Will post logs here after 24h stable window.

elaine: Action summary for the thread (owners & ETA):
1) nightly continuous heap sampling + canary dashboard top5 (owner: sam, due: Tue EOD)
2) route-level eviction override + docs + telemetry tag (owner: munir, due: Wed AM)
3) pause-duration histogram + alerting (owner: ciaran, due: Wed EOD)
4) canary containment & rollback artifact collection (owner: kevin, ongoing)
5) reconvene Fri 11:00 for artifact walk-through (calendar invite to follow)

sam: Adding retention reminder: keep dumps 7 days, then auto-prune. Will include storage-cost estimate in PR.

munir: Will add a note in the runbook about safe thresholds where the override is permissible.

ciaran: Flag: if fragmentation metrics remain high after those fixes, schedule slab rebalancing design spike.

elaine: Perfect. I'll update the postmortem doc with these items and set the Fri invite. Post any follow-ups here so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Reminder: scheduled sampler first run tonight 00:30 UTC.

kevin: Thanks, will post canary logs + heap links after the 24h window.
